original_card.question: What exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained?
methods: Compare exact heads and retained artifacts to write a source-bound disposition receipt.
Audit an existing receipt for missing content or predecessor attribution.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Separate complete integration, partial retention and changed heads; make no autonomous closures.

first_step.inspect: Read one small PR set in the ledger and identify exact reviewed heads and unresolved content.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Compare that set to retained artifacts; produce a complete or explicitly partial disposition receipt.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material.
allowed_variations: One small related PR family or one existing integration receipt.
scope_change_triggers: Treating matching titles or one shared blob as proof of full incorporation.

actual_scope: Exact-head overlap and retention receipt for eight open PRs on the selected #1094 cold replay path (#1101, #1142, #1151, #1277, #1361, #1509, #1646) plus #1108, which #1142 duplicates, against main 1f7a9349.
scope_change_reason: The card names no family; this picks the open replay-tooling family because four members are in the maintainer queue next batch and none had a family-level receipt. No ledger entry exists for these PRs yet, so the receipt compares heads with main rather than with a prior integration receipt.
bottleneck_link: Side result for review throughput: it tells the reviewer that nothing in this family is already retained, that #1142 fails on current main and collides with #1108, and which premises still hold, so the next batch is not reviewed twice or merged into a conflict.
stop_rule: Stop after one receipt for the named family; no correctness review of the PRs, no dispositions, no wider queue census.
evidence: verify.py (default: base-side facts and five receipt-mutation controls; --heads: recomputes per-PR changed paths, retention, clean application, the #1108/#1142 collision and the #1142 capsule pin). RECEIPT.json records each PR's own checks run at the trial merge in this session.
author: Josie Elliston (with Claude)
ai_assistance: Prepared with Claude Code (Claude Opus) in Josie Elliston's donated session. No independent human review.
